`GET /invoices/<id>` in `src/api/invoices.py` now returns a 404 when the invoice doesn't exist. Before, a missing invoice crashed on `invoice.__dict__` and came back as a 500.

```python
invoice = _INVOICES.get(invoice_id)
if invoice is None:
    return errors.problem(404, "Invoice not found", f"No invoice with id {invoice_id!r}.")
```

I haven't been able to run it: Flask isn't installed in this environment, so my quick test failed at import. Installing Flask and requesting a missing ID should show the 404.

I built the error with the project's `errors.problem()` helper, as the project's convention requires. That sends it as an `application/problem+json` (RFC 7807) body with `type`, `title`, `status` and `detail` fields.
